scope_note: This records the third component of Freud's own historical definition; calling it a discipline does not adjudicate the later scientific status of its claims.
statement: Freud's third 1923 sense of psychoanalysis was a growing body of psychological information intended to form a new scientific discipline.
statement_zh: Freud 在 1923 年所列的第三層意義，是逐步累積並形成新科學學科的一套心理學知識。
